messages.author: c98287bf7b1981a7
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] error in eDMR
parts:
Hi Saad,

Please run the following script on your CHG methylation data and send me the plot you get?

plot.dist.myDiff <- function(myDiff, cores=1){
library(doMC, quietly=T)
registerDoMC(cores=cores)
x=myDiff
chr.list=unique(as.character(x$chr))
chr.list=chr.list[chr.list!="chrM"]
dist=foreach(chr = chr.list,.combine=c) %dopar% {diff(sort(x$start[x$chr==chr]))}
log2.distance=log2(dist[dist!=1])
hist(log2.distance)

}

get.dist.myDiff(myDiff)


Cheers,
Sheng

messages.author: c98287bf7b1981a7
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] error in eDMR
parts:
Hi Saad,
How many CHG were captured in your dataset?
I am afraid that CHG might not fit the eDMR distance cutoff assumption. eDMR were developed based on the CpG methylation data and based on the bimodal distribution. But it looks like CHG methylation does not have this feature.
But if you can supply your own distance cutoff (N) to determine regions, then you can still use eDMR functions, specifying dist= N
I suggest you try a couple of N and see which results make more sense to you.
Cheers,
Sheng
